title: Grateful Dead Live at Theatre Hall on 1972-05-16
source: SBD > MR@7.5ips > Reel@7.5ips > DAT > Cass > DAT (DAT-Heads Tree) > PC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Super‑72 soundboard capture of a scorching Luxembourg 1972 set, highlighted by a rippin' Playin' in the Band, classic Pigpen on "It Hurts Me Too" and a slam‑dance Promised Land finale.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this European show, praising the crystal‑clear soundboard mix and the high‑energy first set that blasts through Playin' in the Band into a powerful Promised Land closer. The performance shines with Pigpen’s “It Hurts Me Too” and overall tight groove, despite a few vocal hiccups on Truckin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings, highlighting an exceptional performance and excellent soundboard quality; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a "Super 72' Soundboard" with crisp mix, well‑produced and balanced audio; no notable flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Condensed overview of Europe ’72; first set builds hot momentum with a rippin' Playin' in the Band and ends on an explosive Promised Land closer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His on‑stage banter is called "cheesy" but his vocal performance is praised except for Truckin'.
